question: Which divine form is taken as constant refuge in this declaration?
premises: The lord is described as three-eyed.
The lord is described as having half of Ambikā.
Constant refuge in that body is declared.
inference: We constantly take refuge in the three-eyed lord whose body is half Ambikā.
plain_english: We constantly take refuge in the three-eyed Lord whose body is half Ambikā.
